name: Giacomo Borgia Pallavicini
source:
Head of the Borgia family which owns lots of businesses around the world. He was rushed back to Italy from the us at the age of 20 due to his older brother's accident and consequent coma. Now his brother's deranged 21 year old son is the next in line, unless...
